name: Playa
desc: A cracked dried lakebed running away to the vanishing point — the polygon net is not a tiling but what a drying mud sheet does, shrinking until it fails in tension so the cracks meet at a hundred and twenty degrees, and every plate has curled its edges up off the bed so the lips catch a sun that keeps walking while the lee sides throw their own little shadows, with salt crept out along each crack; cracked playa, a blinding salt pan, a millimetre of standing water that still shows the net through it, a moonlit nocturne, or a cyan survey plan.

energy.doc: how hard the sun bites — highlight on every curled lip, depth of the shadows they throw, and the scroll rate

scale.doc: plate size in world units — at min a fine craquelure, at max metre-wide slabs you could stand on

density.doc: how much grit skids low across the pan

speed.doc: how fast the pan streams toward the viewer

dry.doc: how far the drying has gone — crack width, how hard the plates have curled off the bed, and how much salt has crept out

x.doc: vanishing point x as a canvas fraction

y.doc: horizon y as a canvas fraction — everything above it stays fully transparent so the bg shows through

style.doc: aesthetic: ochre cracked playa under a hard sun / a blinding white salt pan, the crust nearly featureless / a millimetre of standing water lying over it that still shows the net through and holds the sky / a moonlit nocturne, the cracks blacker than the plates / a cyan survey plan — the desiccation net as pure line, no mud at all

seed.doc: drying lottery — where the net nucleated, plate shapes, salt distribution
